summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel RT (Live Patch 26 for SUSE Linux Enterprise Micro 6.0)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.4.0-49.1 fixes various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-53131: netfilter: require Ethernet MAC header before using eth_hdr() (bsc#1269775).
- CVE-2026-63795: 9p: avoid putting oldfid in p9_client_walk() error path (bsc#1272136).
- CVE-2026-63887: scsi: target: iscsi: Bound iscsi_encode_text_output() appends to rsp_buf (bsc#1272386).
- CVE-2026-68158: libceph: Fix multiplication overflow in decode_new_up_state_weight() (bsc#1276303).
